# package: # Locally-provided kernel RPMs for the KERNEL_RPM_SOURCE=local path. Fill in one
# row per RPM with the exact NAME, EPOCH:VERSION-RELEASE, ARCH, and sha256 of the
# RPM. scripts/12a-build-kernel-rpm-carrier.sh verifies every staged RPM against
# these rows (sha256 always; Red Hat signature unless ALLOW_UNSIGNED_KERNEL_RPMS=true)
# before it enters the carrier image. RPM binaries are never committed; stage them
# in KERNEL_RPM_DIR outside this repository.
# Current pin: INSTRUMENTED L1VH kernel `...mgns1.el10`, an UNSIGNED developer
# build that adds logging around MSHV page donation to/from the hypervisor. It is
# being used to test whether the csum_partial #GP (issues/2026-09-09b) lands on
# memory that was donated to MSHV for a VM and then mishandled when returned to
# the Linux kernel on teardown.
# Note the release suffix differs from the previous pin: `mgns1.el10` here versus
# `el10_2` before, same 6.12.0-211.49.1.1794_2798046552 base. EXPECTED_KERNEL in
# l1vh.env must match, or scripts/12b will report the swap as failed.
# RHCOS 10 installs all five of these subpackages, so all five are replaced
# together. The tarball also ships kernel-devel, kernel-devel-matched,
# kernel-modules-extra-matched, kernel-modules-internal and
# kernel-modules-partner; those are NOT installed on RHCOS and are deliberately
# left out of the carrier.
kernel
kernel-core
kernel-modules
kernel-modules-core
kernel-modules-extra
